items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover like-for-like fittings for the failed indoor heating pipe. Four elbows at €15 gross each give €60.

Section 7.1.7(c) covers fittings used in the repair, but §7.1.8(e) excludes dimensions that do not match the repaired installation. The 15 mm replacement tube does not establish that the 28 mm elbows were used; if confirmed, five at €27 gross give €135.

Under §§7.1.7(c) and 7.1.8(e), this fitting is covered only if it corresponds to the section actually repaired. The 28 mm size is not substantiated by the 15 mm replacement tube; one fitting is estimated at €27 gross if covered.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers minor fixings used in the pipe repair. Eight screws at €2 gross each give €16.

Section 7.1.7(c) covers pipe supports used in reinstatement, but §7.1.8(e) requires the size to suit the repaired installation. If these clamps are confirmed as suitable, four at €9 gross each give €36.
The replacement pipe is covered under §§2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c). The full invoiced 6.4 m at €26 gross per metre gives €166.40.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers labour attributable to the pipe repair, not unrelated jobs under §7.1.5. If charged for the repair, the full 6.75 hours at the customary gross rate of about €84 gives approximately €566.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers helper labour attributable to the pipe repair. The full 5.75 invoiced hours give a gross estimate of €394 at the helper-rate prior.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstatement of the existing rock wool insulation. Six pieces at the gross rate prior give approximately €146.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers binding wire used to secure the replacement insulation. The invoiced 2 kg at €12 gross per kg gives €24.
Section 7.1.7(c) allows a lump sum for repair consumables, provided it does not duplicate itemised materials under §7.1.8(c). One allowance is estimated at €30 gross.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge per contractor per invoice. This is the only such charge, at an estimated €80 gross.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of the removed pipe and insulation, not waste from the unrelated work. If this charge is for the pipe repair, one disposal allowance is €62 gross.
The hallway was not affected, so §§3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude repainting even though it appears on the same invoice. The conditional estimate is 12 m² at €20 gross per m², or €240.

Section 7.1.5 excludes the undamaged storage-room floor, and §7.1.6 does not extend cover to a separate room. The conditional estimate for removal and replacement is 15 m² at €85 gross per m², or €1,275.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a) exclude routine servicing of the unaffected outdoor tap. The conditional estimate for one service is €120 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes separately billed processing charges. The conditional estimate for one fee is €25 gross.
